records.name: Vanuatu
records.summary_text:
Vanuatu demands real caution from trans visitors. Same-sex conduct is legal (never criminalised) with no legal gender recognition; there is a small VPride community in Port Vila, and kastom and church conservatism — but no documented anti-trans violence pattern.

records.summary_text: Benin is dangerous for trans visitors. Same-sex conduct is legal, but 76crimes documents that anti-gay lynchings are commonplace; the Hirondelles Club provides safe housing for LGBT youth fleeing family violence. records.name: Niger
records.summary_text:
Niger is dangerous for trans visitors — and newly criminalising: in March 2025 the junta's Charter of Refoundation explicitly outlawed “LGBTQIA+ practices or any other unnatural behavior” for the first time (Article 25). Junta rule, jihadist insurgency, no recourse.

The criminalisation is now codified: a February 2026 revision of the penal code criminalises 'indecent, unnatural, and LGBTQIA+ acts' (penal code article 390; 5–10 years' imprisonment and fines), same-sex marriage (article 391; 10–20 years), and LGBTQIA+ associations (article 392); article 390 also covers anyone who 'artif
